situation: I need to compare EU locations against each other on the variables that differ by site — energy price, carbon intensity, grid headroom, connectivity — and today I face 1–2 days on ENTSO-E plus a half-day on Ember, all producing country averages that mask the zone-level differentials that actually determine which site is better
motivation: run a single query that pulls the spot-specific value for each dimension at each EU NUTS2 zone and ranks zones by how they differ from each other — not by absolute build cost, which is the same everywhere
outcome: show Jordan which zones are comparatively better or worse on the variables that actually vary by location, in hours instead of weeks
quantified_pain: 8–24 hours mechanical data wrangling (S2+S3 combined); country-level averages mask zone differentials worth up to €72/MWh in energy price spread and 50–100 gCO₂/kWh in carbon intensity across EU zones

situation: I have manually ranked sites with arbitrary weights and no audit trail, and I must present to an investment committee who may challenge why Site A ranks above Site B
motivation: back every ranking position with the actual spot-specific differential that drove it — 'Site A ranks above Site B because its energy price is €28/MWh lower and its carbon intensity is 60 gCO₂/kWh cleaner' — citing traceable sources (PyPSA-Eur, Ember, OSM)
outcome: defend the ranking under live IC challenge with numbers, not judgment — and not have the recommendation sent back for rework
quantified_pain: IC deferral adds 1–3 analyst days (€600–€1,700) and a 2-week delay; worst case restarts from S2

situation: Jordan gives me a ranked shortlist but I need to know what choosing Site A over Site B is actually worth — the energy price differential, the carbon cost differential, the PPA discount differential — so I can plug those deltas into our existing financial model
motivation: see spot-specific differentials expressed in €/MWh per site: energy price gap vs EU average, PPA discount at this zone vs day-ahead spot, carbon intensity gap between top candidates — all at our target MW
outcome: quantify the financial value of choosing one site over another from the location-specific variables alone, plug the deltas into our DCF model, and give the CEO a financially grounded recommendation — we already have the build cost; we need what changes by location
quantified_pain: CFO quote: 'I have the build cost. Tell me: if we go to Site A instead of Site B, what does that decision cost or save us in energy over 20 years? Give me the delta.' PPA discount structurally non-public (Pexapark 2026) — without zone-level differential, IC cannot act.

situation: My team brings me a site comparison where trade-offs are buried in an appendix, Jordan and the CFO are not yet aligned on numbers, and there is no clear winner
motivation: receive one ranked recommendation that states plainly how the top site differs from the alternatives — cheaper energy, cleaner grid, less congestion risk — without requiring me to understand grid physics
outcome: make the go/no-go call on which location wins on the variables that differ by site, walk into the board with a defensible trade-off rationale, and know Jordan and the CFO are citing the same differential numbers
quantified_pain: Current alternative: 80-page consultant report (€40k–€120k, static, non-re-runnable) or misaligned CEO deck + CFO Excel. CEO quote: 'I don't need to understand the grid. I need to know which country we're going into and whether we'll be able to say we're running on clean energy.'
